title: Vallerieon
summary: A personal media gallery with a complete publishing workflow.
description: A gallery for photos, videos, and music with a public experience and a separate admin panel. The project includes uploads, content editing, serverless API routes, and cloud storage through Vercel Blob.

title: Nutrimind
summary: A nutrition app with AI meal plans, food scanning, and daily tips.
description: A React and TypeScript interface backed by Flask. It combines food data with AI-assisted meal plans, food scanning, and daily tips, using MariaDB locally and supporting PostgreSQL for deployment.

title: Kopi Malas
summary: A company profile and menu for Kopi Malas Tanggul.
description: A React and TypeScript brand site for a local coffee business. Visitors can explore the drinks, find the location, and prepare an order through WhatsApp; the site does not use a checkout backend.

title: QR Attendance
summary: A browser-based prototype for generating and scanning attendance QR codes.
description: A React prototype with a teacher dashboard for generating attendance QR codes and a student-facing scanner. The current implementation explores the scanning flow; persistent attendance records are not yet implemented.

title: Split TheBill
summary: A shared-subscription platform built as a team project.
description: A platform for coordinating shared digital subscriptions and splitting their cost across members. I worked with the team on the Laravel application and its Bootstrap-based interface.

title: MelodyTix
summary: A concert ticketing demo with event discovery, orders, and admin tools.
description: Rebuilt from an earlier PHP version as a Next.js and React application backed by PostgreSQL. Visitors can browse demo concerts, place simulated orders, track their status, and print approved invoices; admin tools manage events and orders. No real payments are processed.

title: StreamFlix
summary: A streaming product concept focused on independent films.
description: A product design concept for an Indonesian independent-film platform. The interface gives local filmmakers a place to publish their work while keeping discovery and watching familiar for the audience.

title: Gizitron
description: A mobile interface concept for estimating calories, logging meals, and turning food data into useful daily guidance. The work focused on making dense nutrition information quick to read.
